resources.string: Messages that are deleted on the server stay in the chat, marked as deleted. Media that was already downloaded is copied to a private folder so it keeps opening after Telegram clears its cache.
When off, only the deleted mark is shown next to the time.
When off, a message you wrote yourself disappears for good once it is deleted anywhere, including a \"Delete for everyone\" you did on another device. When on, it stays in the chat marked as deleted.
Keep messages when a chat is deleted
Up to 300 of the most recent messages of the chat are archived locally.
Puts saved photos back where Telegram looks for them, so a deleted photo still opens in full size.
Messages kept after the sender deleted them are shown at 60% opacity, so they stand out from the rest of the chat.
Nothing is kept for these chats. Use \"Do not save here\" in the chat menu to add one.
Deleted messages from this chat are no longer kept
Deleted messages from this chat are kept again
